caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile object with symmetric patterns and intricate geometric designs. The textile is positioned vertically and contains a prominent diamond shape located centrally, oriented with one point facing downward. The main field of the textile is filled with repeating, small, interconnected motifs rendered in light black or gray lines with subtle shading. Inside the central diamond, the geometric motifs are denser and arranged in concentric patterns following the shape of the diamond, with hints of light red, blue, and purple tones interspersed throughout. The edges of the textile have borders featuring repeating zigzag and diamond patterns, demarcated by parallel lines. The top and bottom edges have additional horizontal lines and subtle bands of color, primarily soft reds and blues, forming a banded border. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white or beige paper. In the lower left corner, there is handwritten text that reads "Uruk Sheet." The entire composition is finely detailed, with the lines and motifs carefully aligned to create symmetry and balance within the design.
title: Textile
